title: Neural network latent space nominates lapatinib and amiodarone for cardiac hypertrophy
summary: A feedforward neural network trained on ARCHS4 gene expression data was used to map disease signal from a stem cell-derived in vitro model of cardiac hypertrophy to drug targets in DrugBank. This nominated candidates including lapatinib and amiodarone, which reduced proBNP concentration in the in vitro model. Evidence is in vitro only and effect sizes are not in the abstract. Preprint v1 of 2025-01-29.
ai_technology: Feedforward neural network trained on ARCHS4 expression data; latent-space mapping of disease signal to drug targets

evidence.tested: In vitro testing of nominated drugs in a stem cell-derived cardiac hypertrophy model (proBNP concentration).
evidence.unknown: In vivo efficacy, effect sizes and peer-reviewed status are not stated; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A neural network encoded transcriptomic data to link disease signal to candidate repurposed drugs.

source_review.scope: Abstract read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI; author affiliations were not available. Publisher full text not accessed. Author affiliations from OpenAlex metadata.
